title: Green Lantern Corps #22
desc:
"GREEN LANTERN: FIRST LIGHT" PART 2!KRONA RETURNS!

Guy Gardner and Kyle Rayner have entered the Well of the Emotional Entities in a desperate attempt to find Hal Jordan, who is lost in the universe following a cryptic hint from the Book of Oa.

They'll need the new chromatic Alpha Lanterns to work together and manage their powers to face what's on the other side: the decrepit surviving Guardians of the Universe and the monstrous reborn Krona!
